label_note: State labels are physically constrained four-class labels built from speed ratio, density and HF-GO occupancy on XAM-N-6. R/F participate in candidate clustering, while final ordering is constrained by traffic-flow monotonicity. Mean headway, acceleration interference and MGTI are excluded from label construction to reduce leakage in ablation experiments.

RF-OBB.literature_role: Random Forest baseline commonly used in recent traffic-state recognition comparisons.

GBDT-OBB.literature_role: Gradient-boosted decision tree baseline; paired with XGBoost to test boosting-family gains.

KNN-OBB.literature_role: K-nearest-neighbor nonparametric baseline used in recent traffic-state recognition papers.

SVM-OBB.literature_role: Support vector machine baseline frequently used in traffic congestion state recognition.

LR-OBB.literature_role: Linear statistical baseline for checking whether nonlinear models are necessary.

time_series_supplementary.note: Time-series split (last 30% as test). Shown for temporal generalization reference.

time_series_temporal_supplementary.note: Time-series split with causal lag/delta/rolling trend features.

XGBoost-temporal-future.note: XGBoost with current-state score, lag, delta and rolling trend features.

PSO-XGBoost-future.note: External baseline: PSO-tuned XGBoost on OBB/HF-GO feature vector.

LSTM-future.note: LSTM with V+D+F scalar features, 3-seed prediction-average ensemble for fair comparison with GTSEP-DL.

GRU-future.note: GRU temporal baseline (5-year literature), 3-seed prediction-average ensemble.

1D-CNN-LSTM-future.note: External baseline: 1D-CNN encoder followed by LSTM on scalar feature sequences.

LSTSC-future.note: External baseline: lightweight short/long temporal sequence correlation model.

GTSEP-DL.note: GTSEP-DL: 4-channel grid tensor encoded by a compact 2-layer CNN, concatenated with an 8-dimensional scalar stream per frame, then fed to a disturbance-gated LSTM. MGTI is supplied only as the disturbance descriptor controlling candidate-memory writes. Orientation channels are scaled to reduce small-sample heading noise. Reported with the fixed reproducible seed used by the main experiment.

A3: no spatial CNN (flatten+MLP).note: Per-frame MLP on flattened tensor + scalar concat + LSTM.

A4: no LSTM (CNN+mean pool).note: Spatial CNN encoder with temporal mean pooling, LSTM removed.

A5: drop spatial tensor (scalar-only).note: Spatial tensor zeroed out; only scalar features feed the LSTM.

A6: w/o MGTI disturbance descriptor.note: Same disturbance-gated architecture, but the MGTI disturbance descriptor is replaced with zeros.

A7: no disturbance gate (standard LSTM).note: Same CNN and scalar inputs as GTSEP-DL, but replaces the disturbance-gated LSTM with a standard LSTM.

state_balanced_supplementary.note: State-balanced future prediction with +/- horizon embargo around test positions; main prediction remains chronological.

pkdd_generalization.note: PKDD-8 is used as a free-flow transfer check. Metrics against transferred proxy labels are intentionally not reported.
